plugin.name: RankTracker
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Finds you (or anyone) in the yearly/monthly/weekly/daily top 100 rankings

muclient.script:
local PERIODS = { yrank = { cmd = "yrank", label = "Yearly" }, mrank = { cmd = "mrank", label = "Monthly" }, drank = { cmd = "drank", label = "Daily" }, wrank = { cmd = "wrank", label = "Weekly" }, }
-- short "rt" aliases -> the matching rank command local RT = { yrt = "yrank", mrt = "mrank", drt = "drank", wrt = "wrank" }
local VERSION = "1.4" -- keep in step with version= in the plugin tag above local TOP_N = 100 local CATS = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 16, 18 } -- categories to scan local QUIET = 1.0 -- seconds of silence = scan finished
-- known stat columns, in the order they might appear in the table header local COLNAMES = { "Level", "Total Qp", "Mob Kills", "Deaths", "Gquests", "Quests", "Campaigns" }
local scan = nil -- active scan state, nil when idle local lastscan = nil -- finished scan, for rankdebug
-- colours: @x099 yellow, @x045 cyan, @W white, @x048 green -- (also the standard Aardwolf letter codes, needed for the clan tags) local ANSI = { r = "31", g = "32", y = "33", b = "34", m = "35", c = "36", w = "37", D = "1;30", R = "1;31", G = "1;32", Y = "1;33", B = "1;34", M = "1;35", C = "1;36", W = "1;37" }
local function cnote(s) s = s:gsub("@@", "\1") s = s:gsub("@x(%d%d%d)", function(n) return "\27[0;38;5;" .. tonumber(n) .. "m" end) s = s:gsub("@([rgybmcwDRGYBMCW])", function(c) return "\27[0;" .. ANSI[c] .. "m" end) s = s:gsub("\1", "@") AnsiNote(s .. "\27[0m") end
-- shortened clan tags (Aardwolf colour codes; all are 3 visible characters wide) local CLANTAGS = { crimson = "@Y|@RC@Y|", bard = "@W~@RB@W~", druid = "@W/@gD@W\\", gaardian = "@M<@WG@M>", retribution = "@r>@x252R@r>", touchstone = "@G>@WT@G<", loqui = "@w:@rL@w:", xunti = "@r^@bX@r^", amazon = "@m]@GA@m[", twinlobe = "@G!@CT@G!", imperium = "@R>@WI@R>", boot = "@x226|@x048B@x226|", perdition = "@R+@WP@R+", rhabdo = "@W^@WR@W^", light = "@x032)@WL@x032(", hook = "@C}@YH@C{", pyre = "@C/@cP@C\\", masaki = "@W=@RM@W=", watchmen = "@Y|@x238W@Y|", crusader = "@M=@WC@M=", seekers = "@M(@YS@M)", emerald = "@C[@GE@C]", wolf = "@R:@WW@R:", baal = "@r[@RB@r]", tao = "@g/@wT@g/", }
-- tag for a clan name; no clan -> `blank` (spaces to keep columns aligned, or "" for channels) local function clan_tag(clan, blank) blank = blank or "" if not clan or clan == "" then return blank end local k = clan:lower() if k == "none" then return blank end return CLANTAGS[k] or ("@w" .. clan) -- clan without a listed tag: show its plain name end
-- default name: manual override (rankname) > logged-in character (GMCP) > world name local function myname() local n = GetVariable("charname") if n == nil or n == "" then n = GetVariable("selfname") end if n == nil or n == "" then n = WorldName() end return n end
local function shorten(cat) cat = cat:gsub("%s*Completed$", "") return cat end
-- which table column holds this category's total? local function pick_col(cat, cols) local c = cat:lower() local want if c:find("campaign") then want = "Campaigns" elseif c:find("gquest") or c:find("global") then want = "Gquests" elseif c:find("death") then want = "Deaths" elseif c:find("kill") then want = "Mob Kills" elseif c:find("point") or c:find("qp") then want = "Total Qp" elseif c:find("quest") then want = "Quests" elseif c:find("level") then want = "Level" end if want then for i, name in ipairs(cols) do if name == want then return i end end return nil -- known stat but its column isn't in this table: show "?" rather than a wrong number end -- unfamiliar category (e.g. "Powerups (Total)"): match a column named in the title local flat = c:gsub("%W", "") for i, name in ipairs(cols) do local cn = (name:lower():gsub("%s", "")) if flat:find(cn, 1, true) then return i end end -- otherwise assume the ranked value is the last column of the table if #cols > 0 then return #cols end return nil end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP: learn who is logged in ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation(msg_type, data) if msg_type ~= 201 or not data then return end if data:sub(1, 9) == "char.base" then local n = data:match('"name"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if n and n ~= "" then SetVariable("selfname", n) end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- scan engine ---------------------------------------------------------------------
local finish
local function arm(delay, fn) DoAfterSpecial(delay, fn .. "(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
local function touch() scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 arm(QUIET, "OnRankQuiet") end
local function close_cur() if scan.cur then table.insert(scan.done, scan.cur) scan.cur = nil end end
function OnRankQuiet(g) if scan and g == scan.gen then finish() end end
function OnRankStart(g) -- nothing came back at all if scan and g == scan.gen and #scan.done == 0 and not scan.cur then finish() end end
function on_header(name, line, w) if not scan then return end close_cur() scan.cur = { cat = w[2], cols = {}, rows = {}, rank = nil, nums = nil } touch() end
function on_colhdr(name, line, w) if not (scan and scan.cur) then return end local found = {} local hdr = w[1] or "" local covered = {} for _, cn in ipairs(COLNAMES) do local pos = hdr:find(cn, 1, true) if pos then found[#found + 1] = { pos = pos, name = cn } for k = pos, pos + #cn - 1 do covered[k] = true end end end -- any other word in the header is treated as an extra (unknown) column for pos, tok in hdr:gmatch("()(%S+)") do if not covered[pos] then found[#found + 1] = { pos = pos, name = tok } end end table.sort(found, function(a, b) return a.pos < b.pos end) for _, f in ipairs(found) do scan.cur.cols[#scan.cur.cols + 1] = f.name end scan.cur.colidx = pick_col(scan.cur.cat, scan.cur.cols) touch() end
function on_row(name, line, w) if not (scan and scan.cur) then return end local cur = scan.cur local rank, who, clan = string.match(line, "^%s*(%d+)%)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)") -- a name with a space in it (e.g. "MEGAN 2.01") pushes a number into the clan slot: ignore it if clan and clan:match("^[%d%.]+$") then clan = nil end if rank and who then rank = tonumber(rank) local isme = (who:lower() == scan.target:lower()) if scan.rt or scan.top then -- single-category mode: keep every row so the neighbours / top 10 can be shown local nums = {} for n in line:gmatch("%d+") do nums[#nums + 1] = n end cur.rows[rank] = { who = who, clan = clan, nums = nums } if isme and not cur.rank then cur.rank = rank; cur.who = who end elseif not cur.rank and rank <= TOP_N and isme then local nums = {} for n in line:gmatch("%d+") do nums[#nums + 1] = n end local ncols = #cur.cols if ncols == 0 then ncols = 1 end -- stat columns are the LAST ncols numbers on the row (names may contain digits) cur.rank = rank cur.who = who if cur.colidx then cur.total = nums[#nums - ncols + cur.colidx] end cur.nums = nums end end touch() end
-- ranked value of a stored row local function row_total(cur, row) if not cur.colidx then return "?" end local ncols = #cur.cols if ncols == 0 then ncols = 1 end return row.nums[#row.nums - ncols + cur.colidx] or "?" end
local function report(s) local p = s.p if #s.hits == 0 then cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. " Ranks@x045] @x099" .. s.target .. "@W is not in the top " .. TOP_N .. " of any scanned category.") return end
if s.chan then local parts = {} for _, h in ipairs(s.hits) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x045%s @x048#%d@W: @x099%s @x048%s", shorten(h.cat), h.rank, h.who or s.target, h.total or "?") end Execute(s.chan .. " @x099" .. p.label .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") else cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. " Ranks@x045] @x099" .. s.target .. "@W - top " .. TOP_N .. " appearances: @x048" .. #s.hits) for _, h in ipairs(s.hits) do cnote(" @x045" .. shorten(h.cat) .. "@W: @x099" .. (h.who or s.target) .. " @x048#" .. h.rank .. " @W- @x048" .. (h.total or "?")) end end end
-- one category, with the people around the player local function report_rt(s) local p = s.p local c = s.done[1] if not c then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. p.label:lower() .. " ranking came back for category @x048" .. s.catnum) return end if not c.rank then cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. "@x045] @x045" .. c.cat .. "@W: @x099" .. s.target .. "@W was not found in the list.") return end
-- 5 rows: 2 above, the player, 2 below; with nobody above, the window extends below local first = math.max(1, c.rank - 2)
if s.chan then local parts = {} for r = first, first + 4 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then local nm = (r == c.rank) and "@x099" or "@W" local tag = clan_tag(row.clan, "") parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x048#%d %s%s%s @x048%s", r, (tag ~= "" and (tag .. " ") or ""), nm, row.who, row_total(c, row)) end end Execute(s.chan .. " @x099" .. p.label .. " @x045" .. shorten(c.cat) .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") else cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. "@x045] @x045" .. c.cat) for r = first, first + 4 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then local nm = (r == c.rank) and "@x099" or "@W" cnote(string.format(" @x048#%-4d %s %s%-14s @x048%s", r, clan_tag(row.clan, " "), nm, row.who, row_total(c, row))) end end end end
-- top 10 of one category local function report_top(s) local p = s.p local c = s.done[1] if not c then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No " .. p.label:lower() .. " ranking came back for category @x048" .. s.catnum) return end
if s.chan then local parts = {} for r = 1, 10 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then local tag = clan_tag(row.clan, "") parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("@x048#%d %s@x099%s @x048%s", r, (tag ~= "" and (tag .. " ") or ""), row.who, row_total(c, row)) end end Execute(s.chan .. " @x099" .. p.label .. " @x045Top 10 " .. shorten(c.cat) .. "@W - " .. table.concat(parts, "@W, ") .. "@w") else cnote("@x045[@x099" .. p.label .. "@x045] @x045" .. c.cat .. "@W - top 10") for r = 1, 10 do local row = c.rows[r] if row then cnote(string.format(" @x048#%-3d %s @x099%-14s @x048%s", r, clan_tag(row.clan, " "), row.who, row_total(c, row))) end end end end
finish = function() EnableTriggerGroup("scan", false) local s = scan if s.cur then table.insert(s.done, s.cur); s.cur = nil end s.hits = {} for _, c in ipairs(s.done) do if c.rank then s.hits[#s.hits + 1] = c end end scan, lastscan = nil, s if s.rt then report_rt(s) elseif s.top then report_top(s) else report(s) end end
-- "" or "-" means no channel (echo locally) local function norm_chan(chan) if chan == nil or chan == "" or chan == "-" then return nil end return chan end
local function norm_target(t) if t == nil or t == "" then return myname() end return t end
local function start_scan(key, chan, target) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end scan = { p = PERIODS[key:lower()], chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Scanning " .. scan.p.label:lower() .. " rankings for @x099" .. scan.target .. "@W (lists gagged)...") -- send everything at once; replies are split by their headers for _, n in ipairs(CATS) do Send(scan.p.cmd .. " " .. n) -- Send, not Execute: avoids re-entering our own aliases end scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
local function start_rt(key, catnum, chan, target) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end scan = { p = PERIODS[RT[key:lower()]], rt = true, catnum = catnum, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = norm_target(target), gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) Send(scan.p.cmd .. " " .. catnum) scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
local function start_top(key, catnum, chan) if scan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W A scan is already running, hang on.") return end -- key is tyrt/tmrt/tdrt/twrt -> drop the leading "t" to get yrt/mrt/drt/wrt scan = { p = PERIODS[RT[key:lower():sub(2)]], top = true, catnum = catnum, chan = norm_chan(chan), target = "", gen = 0, done = {}, hits = {} } EnableTriggerGroup("scan", true) Send(scan.p.cmd .. " " .. catnum) scan.gen = scan.gen + 1 DoAfterSpecial(6, "OnRankStart(" .. scan.gen .. ")", 12) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------- -- aliases ---------------------------------------------------------------------
function alias_echo(name, line, w) start_scan(w[1], nil, nil) end
function alias_channel(name, line, w) start_scan(w[1], w[2], w[3]) end
function alias_rt(name, line, w) start_rt(w[1], tonumber(w[2]), w[3], w[4]) end
function alias_top(name, line, w) start_top(w[1], tonumber(w[2]), w[3]) end
function alias_name(name, line, w) local n = w[1] if n == nil or n == "" then SetVariable("charname", "") cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Default name is now the logged-in character: @x099" .. myname()) else SetVariable("charname", n) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W Default name set to @x099" .. n) end end
function alias_debug(name, line, w) if not lastscan then cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W No scan has run yet.") return end for _, c in ipairs(lastscan.done) do local colname = c.cols[c.colidx or 0] or "?" cnote(" @x045" .. c.cat .. "@W columns: @x099" .. table.concat(c.cols, ", ") .. "@W total from: @x048" .. colname .. "@W rank: @x048" .. (c.rank and ("#" .. c.rank) or "-")) end end
function alias_help(name, line, w) local who = myname() cnote("@x099===== @x045RankTracker@x099 =====@w @D(this help: @Wrankhelp@D)@w") cnote(" @wFinds you, or anyone, in Aardwolf's yearly, monthly, weekly and") cnote(" @wdaily top " .. TOP_N .. " rankings. Looking up: @x048" .. who .. "@w @D(rankname to change)@w") cnote("") cnote("@x048Full scan@w, every category you place in:") cnote(" @x048yrank@x099 / @x048mrank@x099 / @x048wrank@x099 / @x048drank@w yearly, monthly, weekly, daily") cnote(" @x048drank <channel>@w one coloured line to that channel") cnote(" @x048drank <channel> <name>@w someone else, to that channel") cnote(" @x048drank - <name>@w someone else, echoed only to you") cnote("") cnote("@x048One category@w, you with 2 people above and 2 below:") cnote(" @x048drt <n>@w echoed to you") cnote(" @x048wrt 18 spo@w weekly category 18, one line to spo") cnote(" @x048drt 16 spo Ultimate@w Ultimate and his neighbours, to spo") cnote(" @x048drt 16 - Ultimate@w same, echoed only to you") cnote(" @D(yrt / mrt / wrt / drt for yearly / monthly / weekly / daily)@w") cnote("") cnote("@x048Top 10@w of one category, no name needed:") cnote(" @x048tdrt <n>@w echoed to you") cnote(" @x048tdrt 16 spo@w one coloured line to spo") cnote(" @x048tdrt 16 tell Bob@w sent to Bob as a tell") cnote(" @D(tyrt / tmrt / twrt / tdrt for yearly / monthly / weekly / daily)@w") cnote("") cnote("@x048Settings@w:") cnote(" @x048rankname <name>@w look that player up by default") cnote(" @x048rankname@w back to your logged in character") cnote(" @x048rankdebug@w which column was read as the total") cnote(" @x048rankhelp@w this screen") cnote("") cnote("@x048Notes@w:") cnote(" @wThe full scan covers categories @x048" .. table.concat(CATS, " ") .. "@w. The drt and tdrt") cnote(" @wcommands send whatever number you give straight to the game, so") cnote(" @wother categories work there too.") cnote(" @wClan tags show on the drt and tdrt lists, not on the full scan.") cnote(" @wA channel is one word (@x048spo@x099, @x048clan@x099, @x048gratz@w). Only the top 10") cnote(" @wcommands take two, so that @x048tdrt 16 tell Bob@w works.") cnote(" @wThe game's own numeric forms still pass through untouched:") cnote(" @x048yrank 18@w gives you the MUD's full list.") end
function OnPluginInstall() EnableTriggerGroup("scan", false) cnote("@x045[@x099RankTracker@x045]@W v" .. VERSION .. " loaded. @x048rankhelp@W for the command list.") -- installed mid-session: ask the game for char.base so we learn the character name if (GetVariable("selfname") or "") == "" and IsConnected() then SendPkt(string.char(255, 250, 201) .. "request char" .. string.char(255, 240)) end end
function OnPluginClose() EnableTriggerGroup("scan", false) end
